title: Sam Morgan's band: Alfred Williams, T-Boy and the bass
summary: Vincent recalls Sam Morgan's band, Alfred Williams, Alfred Martin and bassist Eddie Gilmore (T-Boy), who stuck together.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You ever had a yank? He did do yankin'. He used to play with me when I was with Sam Martin. Joe Watson, you had a sign up there. He was playing when I was with him too. And we had Albert Martin. You had got here Albert Martin. He died there about four or five months ago over in Texas. Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.
Oh, Alfred Williams, he's thinking of.

Alfred Williams. Oh no. I used to play with Alfred William. He's there. He went away there a long time. Somebody in Texas. But he come back there. He's been there ever since. I used to play with my band too. Let me see who we was playing with when he used to play with us. Sam Morgan, I bet you anything. We had a regular band. He played with Sam Morgan a long time. Sam Morgan. No, he wasn't with us when he was there. He left. He went away. Because we had Alfred Martin with us when I got in the band.
He went to California with Ari. Yeah, Alfred William. Yeah, I know he did. Let's see. Oh, bass player. You didn't tell us about the bass player.

So you didn't tell him about the bass player yet? With Sam Morgan. With Sam Morgan. Oh, that was Eddie Gilmore. Keybar, I recall. He came with Sam. Who until Sam got sick? And I did too, you know. Oh, yeah. I know what I'm going to say. Ask me if you played. We always worked together, me and T-Boy, you know. Bass and the bass stick together. You know, at a saxophone player, he used to stick too. We wouldn't be doing nothing. We'd always get a band and take your little jobs, you know, like that, and keep us up.
So who was the saxophone player? Well, uh... With T-Boy and him. With T-Boy and you. Who was the saxophone player? Oh, I see. Pelley see. He's there too. I see him there about six or seven years.
